description: Canonical field registry for source_system — an origin of identity evidence. Every ingestion source (CSV, connector, SDK, API, agent_runtime, manual) registers as a source_system before its identities are resolved. Tenant-scoped: tenant_id is part of every identity namespace.

blocks.name: source_system
blocks.description: A registered origin of identity evidence for a tenant.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Owning tenant. Hard boundary — no cross-tenant source systems.

fields.name: provider
fields.description: Optional provider name (shopify, stripe, hubspot, mailchimp, salesforce, etc.).

fields.name: trust_level
fields.description: Trust level of this source for identity evidence.
